name: rotifer
description: The Rotifer Protocol plugin for OpenClaw — three Skills plus the Rotifer MCP server. Create your first Agent from a template (hello), route yourself to the right capability (assistant), and rank an Agent's Genes against live Arena data to swap in stronger ones (evolve). Ranking is the automatic part; every replacement waits for your approval and can be rolled back.

ROTIFER_TELEMETRY.description: Set to 0 (or false/off) to stop all usage reporting. When signed in, each MCP tool call is otherwise reported to Rotifer Cloud — tool name, Gene id, outcome, latency, user id. Installing a Gene also bumps that Gene's public install counter, which carries the Gene id and no identity and fires whether or not you are signed in; this flag stops that too.
